culture_rules.T: biology reaches a text-pretrained LM only as tokens in its own stream (names, sequence letters, new symbolic tokens)
culture_rules.E: biology reaches a text-pretrained LM only as continuous vectors from a biological encoder
culture_rules.H: both channels in the same system
culture_rules.C: generative host is a biology model conditioned on language

culture_notes.full_2026-07-06__rec_003043: Geneverse: coded T (text LLMs on gene/protein names); its LLaVA models are E
culture_notes.full_2026-07-06__rec_001687: CaLMFlow: LM-hosted, biology enters as embedded trajectories (E); text prompts are conditions
culture_notes.update_2026-08-09__manual_recall_xunzi: XunZi: combined text LLM and graph/omics model (H)

dependence_tests.rule: work counts if a removal, mismatch/shuffle, random/noise, content perturbation, order/value ablation or no-biology baseline is charted in both runs, plus steward-adjudicated single-run items

excluded_single_run.full_2026-07-06__rec_000060: noise robustness of images and a downstream survival model; not a dependence test of the proposed model

excluded_with_reason.june_update_2026-06-10__rec_000350|T_con: hypothesised representation constraint, not stated loss
excluded_with_reason.full_2026-07-06__rec_001773|T_knowledge: motivation by LLM training success, not pretrained knowledge

comparison_unit_rules.unit: one cross-representation comparison (arms in different cultures) per work x task family; runs merged

design.controlled: same system varied only in representation
design.same_backbone: authors' system vs the same backbone given the data as text

comparison_unit_rules.winner: culture of the arm the paper reports as better; mixed when the paper reports a split
comparison_unit_rules.opponent: how the non-proposed arm was obtained: prompted general LLM, external frozen embedding/pretrained model, trained baseline or trained ablation

known_charting_misses.found: 2026-10-14, while checking exception U26 (not a systematic audit)
